items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Why do you think it is that Oscar Peterson and George Shearing, Billy Taylor, Calvin Jackson, they can all sit down to play all night

ctx.x: People have a retention span—you can’t play too much music. You have to learn how to cut off and cut on.

Why do you think it is that Oscar Peterson and George Shearing, Billy Taylor, Calvin Jackson, they can all sit down to play all night and not sing or shake hips and they always expect us to do something extra?
Well, if you can do something extra, then you should get two salaries.
